vulnerability.name: USN-8483-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that HPLIP incorrectly handled certain print data. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause HPLIP to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-8631)  It was discovered that HPLIP incorrectly handled certain inputs. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-8632)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in HPLIP.
